intro: Warug of the Magram, pleased with your help after Gizmo for Warug, now wants the head of Khan Shaka, the Khan of the Gelkis. He means to stare at it and laugh at his enemy.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You help the Magram, and I like you. Now, kill the Khan of the Gelkis! He is Khan Shaka, and I want his head! I want to stare at his head and laugh at him!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do tasks for the Magram, and I will help you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Khan Shaka is dead! I will place his head on a pike, and keep it with me so Shaka can see the strength of the Magram!
